//: Type-checks status/js/**/*.js. status/js/*.js stays plain JS on disk — it is served
straight to the browser via a bare <script type="module"> with no bundler in front of it
(see status/index.html), and none of these files are renamed to .ts, so the runtime is
byte-identical to what shipped before. checkJs makes tsc read the JSDoc annotations already
in each .js file (or infer types from usage where JSDoc is absent) and enforce them exactly
as it would for real .ts — this is the mechanism, not a build step. There is no test/ dir
here (unlike client/, this surface has no headless unit tests), so this project is JS-only:
just js/**/*.js, no .ts sources at all.
